Mission.definition: Permanent exam / preparation identity. Mission is NOT a recruitment year. Remains active across multiple recruitment cycles.
Mission.lifecycle: Permanent identity. A completed recruitment cycle does NOT archive or delete the permanent mission.

RecruitmentCycle.definition: Logical entity representing a specific official recruitment cycle instance over time for a mission (or one-off).
RecruitmentCycle.cardinality: 0, 1, or many per Mission over time.
RecruitmentCycle.rule: Do NOT use permanent mission ID itself as cycle ID. Cycle ID must be distinct (e.g. cycle_rpsc_1st_grade_2024_01).

CareerSignalEvent.definition: Time-bound official event derived from official notifications, corrigenda, exam schedules, answer keys, or result declarations.
